name: com.gameframex.unity.ui
description:
GameFrameX UI — Unity UI management package. Opens forms asynchronously returning Task<IUIForm> (full-screen or normal, optionally pausing covered forms), manages UI groups with depth sorting, form visibility, show / hide animations, instance pooling with auto-release, design-resolution scaling, and rich open / close event notifications. Helper backends (FairyGUI / UGUI) self-register through a backend registry, and configuration moves to code-level UIOptions (GameFrameXOptions.Configure: event toggles, pool params, helper factories). Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX UI — Unity 界面管理功能包。异步打开界面返回 Task<IUIForm>（全屏或普通、可暂停被覆盖界面），管理界面组深度排序、界面可见性、显示/隐藏动画、实例池化与自动释放、设计分辨率适配，并发布完整的打开/关闭事件通知。Helper 后端（FairyGUI / UGUI）经后端注册表自注册，配置收敛为代码级 UIOptions（GameFrameXOptions.Configure：事件开关、池参数、Helper 工厂）。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
